thread.title: Apple: iPhone X, Record Profits A Much Higher Price - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Victor Dergunov
title: Apple: iPhone X, Record Profits A Much Higher Price - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Source: TheVerge.com
iPhone X, Record Profits, and a Much Higher Stock Price Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) is trading at a new all-time high once again, and is now only about 7% or $13 away from becoming the first publicly traded trillion-dollar company in the world. I’ve owned Apple throughout most of the time since 2006, and in that time frame, the stock has appreciated by about 2,000% .
Source: MacroTrends.net
My main catalyst for owning the stock then was the iPhone, and that reasoning remains true today. The iPhone X should significantly propel Apple’s revenues, improve gross profit, and lead to much more net income than most analysts are expecting over the next 12-18 months. Due to this, Apple continues to be the single-largest holding in my portfolio. Ultimately, it appears the company is destined to rise to a trillion-dollar valuation very soon, and should then proceed to go much higher after that.
